# solana-gossip, vendored from agave v4.3.0

Generated by `vendor/vendor-gossip.py` from agave's `gossip/` crate, with the
changes below. All of them cut traffic a relaying validator needs and Colibri
does not.

## Push only our own values

`src/cluster_info.rs`, `new_push_requests`: the push filter keeps only values
whose origin is this node.

```rust
value.pubkey() == self_id && should_retain_crds_value(...)
```

## Why

Agave pushes every fresh value in its table, whoever it came from, to 9 peers
(`crds_gossip_push.rs`, `new_push_messages`). A validator on a datacenter link
relays the cluster's gossip this way. Colibri on a home connection measured
~12,600 push packets/s out against ~4,300 gossip packets/s in, and the link
went down.

Colibri needs from gossip only that its own ContactInfo (and its TVU address,
which Turbine sends shreds to) is known, and that it learns peers by pulling.
Pushing its own values keeps the first; pulls are untouched.

## Prune every pusher, and pull slowly

Even relaying nothing, Colibri still received gossip at ~13,900 packets/s
(~100 Mbit/s, `nettop` on the gossip socket, 2026-10-19): ~6,300/s pushes from
peers that keep it in their active sets, and ~3,000/s pull responses, almost
all vote churn. With turbine (~6,300 packets/s, ~60 Mbit/s) that saturated the
home Wi-Fi: 40-46% ping loss at 1.2-1.7 s RTT while Colibri ran, turbine
"dips", and lost repair answers.

- `crds_gossip_push.rs`: `CRDS_GOSSIP_PRUNE_MIN_INGRESS_NODES` 0, not 2, so
  every pusher of every origin is pruned instead of keeping two.
- `received_cache.rs`: `MIN_NUM_UPSERTS` 2, not 20, so pruning starts after a
  pusher's first few values.
- `cluster_info.rs`: pull every 500 ms for the first 30 s (to fill the peer
  table), then once a minute (`STARTUP_PULL_ROUNDS`, `SLOW_PULL_PERIOD`).
  Colibri reads only ContactInfos, whose addresses rarely change.

Measured together: gossip in 13,900 → ~2,000 packets/s (100 → 10 Mbit/s),
ping 0% loss at 58 ms average while Colibri runs.

Not advertising a gossip address (so nobody pushes at all) is not an option:
the node then gets no turbine.

## Upgrading agave

```
vendor/vendor-gossip.py <agave checkout at the new tag> <tag>
```

then apply the changes above again, and move the `tag` in `shred-net/Cargo.toml`.
